label: Eighty Six (the game in ~/Games/eightysix)
about: Voices for the Eighty Six game. Riku's crew owns the game: this file only reads its dialogue and writes clips to outputs/, nothing in the game is edited. Until Emerson's season 1 episodes are cut into clips, Lena and Shin speak with stand-in voices, not cloned from the anime's voice actors: in English a Kokoro preset voice reads the sample (AuK's design mode made breathy clips that clone badly, docs/library/voice/2026-10-09-voice-cloning-bakeoff.md), in Japanese Irodori designs the voice from the game's speaker notes. A voice later cloned from an actor gets private: true in its profile: fine on this laptop, never shared.

en.label: Lena (stand-in)
en.sample: This is Handler One. From today I will be in charge of your squadron. I look forward to working with all of you.

ja.label: Lena (stand-in, Japanese)
ja.describe: 十八歳くらいの若い女性の指揮官。澄んだ柔らかい声で、丁寧で真面目、礼儀正しく、内に温かさがある。落ち着いた速さで話す。
ja.sample: こちらハンドラー・ワン。本日より、皆さんの指揮を担当します。よろしくお願いします。

en.label: Shin (stand-in)
en.sample: Undertaker to all units. The Legion are moving. Hold your positions and wait for my signal.

ja.label: Shin (stand-in, Japanese)
ja.describe: 十七歳くらいの若い男性の隊長。低めの落ち着いた男性の声で、静かで淡々としている。感情をほとんど見せず、短く話す。
ja.sample: アンダーテイカーより各機へ。レギオンが動き出した。持ち場を維持し、合図を待て。
